name: design-taste-frontend
tagline_zh: 别再交出千篇一律的落地页。它先读需求再定设计方向，重设计先审计，上线前强制自检——每个界面都像为你量身定制。
tagline_en: Stop shipping templated landing pages. It reads your brief, picks a real design direction, audits before.
desc_en: Anti-slop frontend skill for landing pages, portfolios, and redesigns. The agent reads the brief, infers the right design direction, and ships interfaces that do not look templated. Real design systems when applicable, audit-first on redesigns, strict pre-flight check.
why_zh: 同类只会套组件库，它先推断设计方向再动手，重设计强制审计，从机制上杜绝模板感。
why_en: Unlike tools that just reuse components, it infers direction first, audits redesigns, and pre-flights—so output never looks.
